This loss of 3 regions is due to the 4 lines intersecting at a single point instead of producing the 6 distinct pairwise intersections expected in a general position.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If exactly two cuts perfectly overlap, the number of pieces drops to 6.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If three cuts overlap, it drops to 4.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"In a general position, 4 lines yield C(4,2) = 6 pairwise intersection points. The formula for max regions R = 1 + n + (number of intersections). For 4 general lines, R = 1 + 4 + 6 = 11. If all 4 lines are concurrent, they share exactly 1 intersection point. Thus R = 1 + n + 1 = 1 + 4 + 1 = 6, but we must account for the unbounded rays. Actually, each of the 4 lines is divided into 2 rays by the origin, resulting in 8 unbounded sectors. Therefore, the pizza has exactly 8 pieces.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
